senses.gloss:
ध्यै ध्यै [cf. the older form 1. धी], cl.
1. P. (ep. also A.) ध्यायति (ep. also ध्याति,
2nd sing. Impv. ध्याहि), Pot. ध्यायेत्, दध्यौ,
ध्याता, ध्यास्यति, अध्यासीत्, ध्यातुम्, to think
of, have in mind, imagine, contemplate, ponder,
meditate, think on, meditate on, reflect upon (with
or without मनसा or मनसि or चेतसा or धिया),
to call to mind, recollect: Caus. ध्यापयति, -यितुम्:
Desid. दिध्यासति: Intens. दाध्यायते, दाध्याति,
दाध्येति; [cf. Gr. θέα, θεά-ο-μαι, related to ध्यै,
as Lat. vid-ere to Sanskrit विद्, ‘to know;’ or as
Zend बुध्, ‘to see,’ to Sanskrit बुध्, ‘to know.’]
